title: An organization's SSO enforcement committed (OP-155 m.3 (i))
description: The member of the SET `events` claim, and of the CloudEvent `data.events`, under `urn:suiss:access:event:org.sso_enforced`. Its members' passwords, API tokens, sign-ins and refresh families ended; `invitations` says what happened to the pending invitations. A notification, never an authority source (INV-24).
